units.source_text: 果然，靠近门口的走廊上并排放着一把铁铲和两个有把手的石油桶。

en.t: Sure enough, in the corridor near the doorway, an iron shovel and two oil cans with handles had been placed side by side.

units.source_text: 这一定就是刚才有人叫“多拿来一个人用的”，从道路上扔下来的那些铁玩意儿。

en.t: These must have been the iron things someone had just called for, saying, "Bring enough for one more person," and then thrown down from the road.

units.source_text: 他觉得这安排准备也出色过头了，自己像被看中了似的。

en.t: He felt that the arrangements and preparations were almost too well done, as though he himself had been singled out.

units.source_text: 说是这么说，可是，究竟有什么地方被人看中了呢，连他自己都还搞不清楚。

en.t: Still, he himself had no idea what it was about him that had supposedly been singled out.

units.source_text: 反正，一想到这种过于轻视人的做法，他便觉得阴森森的，好没趣。

en.t: In any case, when he thought of this excessively contemptuous way of treating people, he felt gloomy and thoroughly disgusted.

units.source_text: 铁铲的杂木手柄上，闪着黑乎乎油腻的光，还结着许多粗大的树瘤。

en.t: The mixed-wood handle of the shovel gave off a dark, greasy sheen and was covered with many large, rough knots.

units.source_text: 他几乎丧失了伸手去抓的勇气。

en.t: He had almost lost the courage to reach out and take hold of it.
